title: Relay Balanced Cuts
statement:
A relay log records signed energy adjustments in time order. Split the log at a gap between two consecutive entries, leaving at least one entry on each side. A cut is balanced when the sum of the entries before the gap equals the sum after it. Return the number of balanced cuts. Count gaps separately, preserve the order, and do not remove an entry. Negative and zero totals are allowed. A one-entry log has no legal cuts.

Example 1: [2, -1, 1, 2] returns 2: cuts after the first and third entries each leave totals of 2.
Example 2: [0, 0, 0] returns 2: both internal gaps qualify.
Example 3: [5] returns 0: both sides must be nonempty.
constraints:
1 <= len(adjustments) <= 100000
-1000000 <= adjustments[i] <= 1000000
Return an integer. Intermediate sums can exceed signed 32-bit range. Aim for O(n) time and O(1) extra space.

examples.explanation: The cuts after entries 1 and 3 each leave sum 2 on both sides.
Both internal gaps are balanced; outside gaps are illegal.
